_comment: Cue player protocol. Knob-style schema -- see cue_player.py docstring for the explicit-events alternative. All durations are in seconds.
_orientation_doc: Each wrist orientation re-runs the full gesture list. Markers get a '@<orientation>' suffix (e.g. cue_start:index_flex@supinated:rep_3). Before each block a long READY cue 'posture_<orientation>' prompts the participant to rotate their wrist; posture_setup_s controls its duration.
_randomize_doc: Set randomize_gestures to true to shuffle gesture order independently per orientation block. Add a 'seed' integer for reproducible randomization (same seed = same order every run).
_gesture_selection_rationale: Narrowed to 8 gestures that maximally recruit wrist-crossing muscles (FDS, FDP, FPL, FCR, FCU, ECR, ECU, EDC), producing the largest EMG topography shift across wrist orientations. This set is designed to characterise orientation-dependent decoder degradation and validate IMU-gating. Excluded gestures are prefixed with '_' and kept for reference.

_gesture_groups._doc: Grouped here for readability; the cue_player only consumes the flat 'gestures' list below. Edit either, but keep them in sync.

individual_finger_flex._exclusion_reason: Middle/ring/pinky FDS patterns are near-indistinguishable from index_flex on surface electrodes; redundant for classification across orientations.

individual_finger_extend._exclusion_reason: thumb_extend included: EPL/EPB run in anatomically separate extensor compartments (1st/3rd) from EDC, shift distinctly across wrist orientations, and complete the thumb flex/extend pair. index_extend excluded: EIP co-activates EDC on surface arrays and clusters near hand_open. middle/ring/pinky extend excluded: pure EDC, indistinguishable from partial hand_open.

thumb_opposition._exclusion_reason: FPL + FDS-index pattern is the same across all pinch variants on surface EMG; redundant classes.

whole_hand._exclusion_reason: Hook/lumbrical involve intrinsics (lumbricals, interossei) which do not cross the wrist -- low orientation-dependency and hard for participants to isolate reliably.

wrist._note: All 4 wrist DOFs retained. FCU (ulnar dev) partially overlaps wrist_flex in neutral, but diverges across pronation/supination -- useful test case for orientation-dependent ambiguity.
